reviews.comment: Rodrigo is easily one of my favorite professors. Nicest guy ever. The course itself can pose a couple challenges, but it truly is very manageable, and he makes the lectures as interesting as possible. Exams are open note and I didn't attend lecture as much as I should have but still managed As and Bs on all of them. Definitely recommend!

Dr. Bombardi was hilarious and his exams are open note (but timed). The quizzes on Canvas had unlimited attempts so there is no reason to not get 100s on the quizzes. The exams are somewhat tricky simply because it covers so much content, but using the my notes, his slides, and the quizzes on the exam made it much more manageable.

I'm usually cozy in the back of class, but I'm glad I sat in the front row for this one. He has a great sense of humor and really cares about the understanding. He actively encourages student input and questions between slides, and is very understanding of disability accommodations. If this weren't my last semester, I'd take him 10 times over!

Loved Bombardi! On top of the material being super clear, the man is a comedic powerhouse. His in-person lectures were engaging and actually made me want to be active in the class. Quizzes were online, at-home, open-book, and if you just pay attention you'll know what they're on. The final project was a presentation over whatever you wanted. Great!

I loved this professor! Bombardi was a great professor who really cares about his students. His lectures are heavy but his test material is straight from his lecture notes. If you pay attention and take notes, it is an easy A or B. He is always available for questions and will help you with anything you don't understand. He will not give up on you.

Dr. Bombardi is such a good person and professor. Hes so kind and caring and does his best to accommodate if you just talk to him. Hes a sweet soul and cares about what hes teaching! His class is also generally easy; he posts all his lectures to eCampus and its easy to pass if you put in minimal effort.
funny professor. class is designed for students to pass. as long as you put a reasonable amount of time studying and take the content seriously, it should be very easy to get a high grade

Dr. Bombardi has been a good prof. He allows cheat sheets on tests, but in general he is more than happy to answer any questions you may have and does his best to tailor the class to the students. This is a semester-long group project. There are in-class activities every Friday.

Loved this prof!! He is funny, caring, and knows his stuff for sure. He will have in class extra credit questions, so go to class. Exams are not too bad - study power points. He has easy online quizzes. Also gives a lot of extra credit at the end which boosted my grade up a whole letter grade! Does not have a lot of assignments.

Bombardi is one of the nicest profs I have ever had. He genuinely cares about his students, especially their mental health. Lectures are interesting and he always adds a few jokes or funny things about him in the presentations. I recommend going to class because he does have small assignments that are graded on participation.

have to attend class for in class assignments-basically show up and you get graded by participation- thought this class was going to be super easy but i was shocked at how hard the tests were- i was scared about my grade being a D at the beginning of the semester but he major curves it at the end and I ended with a high B

He stated on the first day that he was at TAMU to do research, therefore I don't think he was qualified to teach this class. He can be very confusing & doesn't seem to know the material well himself. All the lectures are posted online and class is often released early. If you go to class and put in a little effort you should do fine.
Very lenient and understands when you had a legitimate reason for missing a due date.

reviews.comment: Take this prof. end of discussion. why are you still here? sign up for him already. Super funny and really nice! Loved his class
English is second language, hard to understand, poor communication skills in English (especially about geography)

Professor Bombardi was amazing in that he was funny and sometimes included fun facts or stories in his lectures to spice it up. However, even though the material was fairly simple to understand and straightforward, his test questions were very tricky. He does give many opportunities for E.C per exam (3 exams) and I needed them all! Not an easy A!
